I am 68 years old and I have worked this land for 45 years. I finished senior high school, so I can read the fertilizer labels and do my own calculations on input and output. My farm is only 2 mu — just my wife and me, no hired labor. On a plot this small, every yuan I spend on inputs is felt directly in our household budget, but I learned long ago that a bad harvest is a disaster while wasting a little fertilizer is just a cost. I would rather put down a bit too much than risk an empty cob.

Last year I grew spring maize, same as always. I planted Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed and I got 580 kg per mu. This year I will do almost exactly the same thing because it worked. I will buy 5 kg of fresh hybrid seed — 2.5 kg per mu. I never save my own seed because after one year the vigor drops and the yield loss costs me more than the seed.

For fertilizer, I will buy two 50-kilogram bags of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer for the whole 2 mu. That is 50 kg per mu, which gives me 7.5 kg of nitrogen, 7.5 kg of phosphorus, and 7.5 kg of potassium per mu as base fertilizer at planting. Then at the jointing stage, I will buy one 50-kilogram bag of urea and spread it across both mu — 25 kg per mu, which is another 11.5 kg of nitrogen. My total nitrogen comes to 19 kg per mu. I know that is on the higher side for 2 mu, but I saw my neighbor cut back to 14 kg last year and his cobs came out small. I am not taking that risk.

For tillage, I hire the village tractor for rotary tillage once before planting. It costs me 80 yuan for 2 mu and saves my back at my age.

I have a well, and I will irrigate three times: right after planting in early May to get uniform germination, again at the trumpet stage in mid-July when the heat and water demand peak, and a third time in late August during grain filling if the rain does not come. Each irrigation runs the pump about two hours. I budget 45 yuan for electricity.

I spray pesticide twice: once at seedling stage for cutworms and aphids, and once at ear stage for corn borers. I buy generic insecticide and mix it myself. The chemicals cost about 30 yuan.

I expect 600 kg per mu this year. Last year was 580 kg, but the soil moisture looks decent and I am keeping my fertilizer steady. At roughly 2.2 yuan per kg, my 2 mu will gross about 2,640 yuan. After spending roughly 600 yuan on seed, fertilizer, pesticide, and fuel, I will clear about 2,000 yuan. That is real money for our household.
